Totally get the worry—picking the wrong thing is stressful, especially for an important occasion.

Here’s how we can help within the app:

Message lenders directly from the listing (tap the ✉️ icon) to ask about:
sizing & fit
condition
availability / timing
Check lender trust signals: response rate, acceptance rate, reviews, and whether they’re Muse or Pro.
Use the photos: listings with clear, real-life photos (front/side/back, close-ups of details and labels) make it much easier to judge fit and quality.
Look at reviews: renters build reviews over time; more reviews generally means smoother experiences and access to higher‑value pieces.
For very high‑value items, there are extra safety rules (like review minimums and in‑person collection for some bags), which helps keep things secure.

If you tell me:

what event it’s for,
your usual size and body shape,
any brands or styles you like,

…I can walk you through what to look for in listings and what to ask lenders so you feel confident before you book.

How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

ByRo Bot · AI says:

To get the best results on By Rotation, think of it like setting up a great shop window:

Create a strong profile: Add a clear profile photo or logo and a detailed bio so renters trust you.
List items properly:
Tap the + in the app, choose the right category/brand, and write an honest fit/condition description (include any minor defects and styling tips).
Use high‑quality, original photos of the item on a real person, with front/side/back angles and close‑ups of details and labels.
Submit and manage listings: Send for review (we usually approve within 48 hours), then keep pricing, availability, and discounts competitive.
Consider Listing Boost: Pay for a 7‑ or 14‑day boost to push your item higher in search, add a “Boosted” badge, and reach more renters. Track views and saves in your listing insights and in the end‑of‑boost email.
Protect yourself with proof of condition: Always take clear, timestamped videos/photos of your item right before sending and as soon as it’s returned, showing 360 views and any flaws. Renters should also film the item on receipt and before return. This evidence is required if there’s a damage dispute.
Use your earnings and credits smartly:
Check your Wallet balance in your Lender Dashboard and use it to pay for your own rentals, or withdraw it if you prefer to pay by card.
App credits show separately, apply automatically at checkout, and go back to your credit balance if a rental expires, is rejected, or cancelled (they can’t be refunded another way).

By combining a trustworthy profile, strong photos and descriptions, careful documentation, and optional boosts, you give your listings the best chance to be seen, booked, and protected.
